details: The package contains four files and no static or traced findings indicate installer-side harm. No lifecycle scripts, no outbound network calls to attacker-controlled destinations, no credential or environment-variable scraping, no filesystem persistence, and no fetch-and-execute patterns are present. The package appears to be a small or placeholder module with no supply-chain attack behavior affecting installers.
